tools.name: find_courts
tools.description: Search the directory of places to play tennis in New York City. Filter by borough, by how you get on a court (walk_on, reservation, private_club), by indoor play, by floodlights, or by minimum court count. Returns each venue with its page URL.

tools.name: get_court
tools.description: Everything the directory holds about one venue: courts, surfaces, floodlights, indoor season, accessibility, reservation programmes, coordinates, and the source each fact was read from. Takes the slug returned by find_courts.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "how_to_play_tennis_in_nyc" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.
